tool.name: subdomain_enum
tool.description:
Multi-source subdomain enumeration with bounded per-source budgets.
Replaces single-source subfinder enumeration with seven complementary sources:
- **subfinder** — passive (CT logs, common providers). ~5–50 results typical. - **amass** — deeper active+passive enum. Bigger, slower, finds more. - **dns_bruteforce** — query each entry in a wordlist against the apex. Default wordlist is ~150 common names. Custom wordlist via `wordlist=`. - **wayback** — query archive.org's CDX API for historical URLs containing the apex; extract subdomains. No API key required. - **crtsh** — query crt.sh for every TLS cert ever issued for `*.`. Every internal service that ever got a Let's Encrypt cert is in here, even if it never appeared in DNS. Free, no key required. - **certspotter** — query SSLMate's certspotter API for the same CT data via a different log set. Free, no key required (rate-limited). - **permutations** — apply `prod-` / `staging-` / `-internal` etc. transformations to already-discovered seeds; resolve each candidate. Auto-uses results from the other sources as seeds; can be overridden via `permutation_seeds`.
Each source emits one `check.started` / `check.completed` event (category = `subdomain_enum`). Each source is bounded by `max_per_source` to cap total network volume.
Use this in place of relying on subfinder alone — typical real-world coverage gains are 5–10× the subfinder-only count.
Used internally by `domain_recon_pipeline` (replacing the previous single- source enumeration step).

parameter.name: sources
parameter.description: Comma-separated subset of {subfinder, amass, dns_bruteforce, wayback, crtsh, certspotter, permutations}. Default: "default" runs subfinder + amass + dns_bruteforce + wayback + crtsh + certspotter (permutations auto-runs after if seeds were found). "all" runs everything explicitly. Subset like "crtsh,certspotter" restricts to CT-only.

parameter.name: wordlist
parameter.description: Path to a custom wordlist file (one entry per line, # comments). Used by dns_bruteforce. Defaults to a built-in ~150-name list of common subdomain prefixes.

parameter.name: max_per_source
parameter.description: Hard cap on subdomains kept per source. Default 1000. Caps total network volume; bruteforce respects this before iterating the rest of the wordlist.

parameter.name: permutation_seeds
parameter.description: Comma-separated subdomains to use as permutation seeds. When omitted, the union of other sources' results is used.

returns.description:
{success, domain, sources_run, per_source_counts, subdomains, total_unique}.
`per_source_counts` shows how many each source contributed before deduplication. `subdomains` is the merged + deduped + sorted list.
